scope: primary-source audit of universal nonlinear KMS J/E pi bound and p=1 regularity endpoints

items.claim: A prior primary theorem proves J >= pi E for every finite-dimensional KMS-symmetric QMS, with arbitrary untouched finite references and faithful joint inputs, and establishes pi sharpness.
items.strongest_checked_prior: KT Def. 9 and Conj. 19: weak p=1 would yield system-only J>=2E; strong p=1 would yield system-only J>=4E, but both endpoints are conjectural in the general primitive KMS class. Bardet proves strong C=4 under stricter GNS/sigma_Tr detailed balance.
items.separate_static_prior: Franz-Hiai Theorem 2.2 yields exact pi operator-convex threshold for a Petz Jeffreys/Hellinger state-pair inequality; it does not compare the QMS generator to the KMS-root energy.
items.decisive_missing_interface: A source theorem must insert an arbitrary KMS generator into the nonlinear entropy/root-Dirichlet comparison and retain the all-ancilla quantifier; static operator convexity and ordinary MLSI do not provide this conversion.
